Itemized Passive Description:
*Activates the Entrance Animation when there is another
"Bond of Master and Disciple" Category ally on the team
upon the character's entry*
- {passiveImg:once}Damage reduction rate 30%{passiveImg:up_g} for 1 turn
- {passiveImg:once}{passiveImg:forever}ATK & DEF 200%{passiveImg:up_g} and guards all attacks
*Basic effect(s)*
- ATK & DEF 200%{passiveImg:up_g}
- Receives an additional Ki +1 per Ki Sphere obtained
- Chance of performing a critical hit & damage reduction rate 40%{passiveImg:up_g}
*For every attack received*
- {passiveImg:forever}Ki +2 (up to +8)
- {passiveImg:forever}ATK & DEF 50%{passiveImg:up_g} (up to 200%)
*As the 1st attacker in a turn*
- DEF 100%{passiveImg:up_g} before attacking
*After receiving an attack as the 1st attacker in a turn*
- ATK 100%{passiveImg:up_g}, chance of performing a critical hit 40%{passiveImg:up_g} and
all allies' Ki +2 within the turn
*After receiving an attack as the 2nd or 3rd attacker in a turn*
- All allies' Ki +2 and ATK, DEF & chance of performing a critical hit
20%{passiveImg:up_g} for 2 turns
*When HP is 30% or less at the start of the character's attacking turn
after the character receives 4 or more attacks in battle*
- {passiveImg:once}Fully recovers HP
- {passiveImg:forever}Chance of performing a critical hit & damage reduction rate
15%{passiveImg:up_g}
